description: This is a Java test class for the RqlOptionParser, which tests parsing RQL options such as sort, limit, cursor, and size within a specific package. The file contains unit tests that verify correct parsing, error handling, and the inverse relationship between parsing and unparsing functionalities.

classes.name: RqlOptionsParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing RqlOptionParser's parsing logic for different RQL option expressions.

methods.name: parseSortWithOnePropertyAscending
methods.description: Tests parsing of a sort option with one property in ascending order.

methods.name: parseSortWithOnePropertyDescending
methods.description: Tests parsing of a sort option with one property in descending order.

methods.name: parseSortWithSeveralProperties
methods.description: Tests parsing of a sort option with multiple properties and alternating order.

methods.name: invalidSortMissingOrder
methods.description: Ensures that missing sort order throws a ParserException.

methods.name: invalidSortMissingOrderAtSecondProperty
methods.description: Ensures that a missing order in the second property throws a ParserException.

methods.name: parseLimitSuccess
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid limit option with offset and count.

methods.name: invalidLimitMissingNumber
methods.description: Ensures that missing arguments in limit throw a ParserException.

methods.name: invalidLimitTooManyArguments
methods.description: Ensures that too many arguments in limit throw a ParserException.

methods.name: parseOptionCombinations
methods.description: Tests parsing a combination of multiple options.

methods.name: parseAndUnparseAreInverseOfEachOther
methods.description: Verifies that parsing and unparsing produce inverse results.

methods.name: invalidLimitArgumentsExceedsLong
methods.description: Ensures large limit values exceeding Long range throw a ParserException.

methods.name: cursorWithoutContentOrClosingParenthesis
methods.description: Ensures malformed cursor expressions throw a ParserException.

methods.name: cursorWithoutClosingParenthesis
methods.description: Ensures malformed cursor expressions missing parenthesis throw a ParserException.
